verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managed payout schedules applied to balance accounts (daily/weekly/monthly cadence) as well as custom payout timing via API, plus CashOut for instant access to funds, directly matching the story's scheduling and instant-payout needs. However, the evidence doesn't spell out per-seller granularity (schedules are applied per location/currency group) or specifics on instant payouts to cards/real-time rails. Missing for 10: explicit per-seller schedule configuration detail, instant-to-card/real-time-rail specifics, and independent confirmation beyond vendor docs.
